---
title: "The Bond Films"
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
```

## The Bond Films

```{python}
#| include: false

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
```

@fig-bond-revenue shows how worldwide revenue changed across the Bond films in the dataset.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-bond-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Worldwide revenue of James Bond films over time"

plt.plot(
    bond["year"],
    bond["revenue_musd"],
    marker="o"
)

plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (million USD)")
plt.show()
```

The Bond films in the dataset span from `{python} int(bond["year"].min())` to `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`.
